Gaming2023-2025

Lotus

Serious Game

Educational video game in Unity 3D that teaches emotional intelligence through gameplay. Winner of the ILAN 2023 Award (Israel-Mexico). Presented in Israel.

Role
UX Designer & Gameplay Developer
Stack
Unity 3DC#FigmaGame UX Design
Overview

Lotus is a serious game designed to teach emotional intelligence through interactive play. The project combines narrative, exploration, and guided decision-making to help players recognize emotions and practice healthier responses in a safe digital environment.

Focus

The work centered on translating learning goals into game mechanics, UX flows, and Unity systems. I contributed to the gameplay structure, interface decisions, and interaction design so the experience could feel approachable while still supporting the educational purpose.
